question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Advocate
solution:
The correct answer is "Support."

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• "Advocate" means to recommend or say that you support a particular plan or action. ((किसी योजना या कार्रवाही का) समर्थन करना; सिफ़ारिश करना)

 
 
• Example: **She **advocates**__ taking a more long-term view.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the word "support" is the most appropriate synonym of the given word.
 
• **"Support" **means to help somebody by saying that you agree with him/her/it, and sometimes giving practical help such as money. (किसी को (सहमति के आधार पर) समर्थन देना या किसी की (धन देकर) सहायता करना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *My father **supported**__ the Labour Party all his life.*
 
 
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.**

• Justice: **the quality of being just, impartial, or fair. (न्यायसंगत, निष्पक्ष या निष्पक्ष होने का गुण)
 
• **Experience: **the things that you have done in your life; the knowledge or skill that you get from seeing or doing something. (जीवन में किए गए काम; किसी काम कों देखने अथवा करने से प्राप्त ज्ञान अथवा कौशल, अनुभव, तजुरबा)
 
• **Forever: **for all time; permanently. (हमेशा के लिए; स्‍थायी रूप से)
